correctness.rationale: The exact normalization E_v(t)=(exp(-2tL))_vv-1/n correctly reduces rankings to graph heat diagonals at s=2t. Enumerating the ten unlabeled connected graphs of orders <=4 gives seven nonzero spectral difference formulas (P3, star, P4, paw three pairs, diamond) all strictly positive q=e^-s∈(0,1); each same-degree pair is symmetry-equivalent. The bull Laplacian at (a,b,c,d,e) has eigenvalues 0,(5-√13)/2,(5-√5)/2,(5+√5)/2,(5+√13)/2; the projector differences are A e^-αs -B e^-βs -C e^-γs +D e^-δs, with A=(13-3√13)/52, B=(5+√5)/20,C=(5-√5)/20,D=(13+3√13)/52, all positive. It has F(0)=0, F’(0)=-1, slow-mode coefficient A>0; after dividing by e^-αs, the rescaled derivative changes sign once because the further exponentially rescaled derivative is strictly increasing from negative to infinity. Therefore precisely one simple positive zero. I checked the radical identities and numerical root independently with exact/sufficient-precision arithmetic; the numeric value is not a proof of uniqueness.
